ai_summary: Advait Energy Transitions Limited, as a member of a consortium, has been granted an electricity distribution license by the Haryana Electricity Regulatory Commission (HERC) for the Gurugram and Nuh districts. This marks a significant strategic milestone, expanding Advait's footprint into India's evolving power distribution sector and enabling it to contribute expertise in new/renewable energy and decarbonization initiatives. No red flags are apparent in this positive announcement.
